notes.title: Update released!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mini Tone and providing feedback!

We've just implemented a feature that discretely shows the launch angle when preparing the release of the ball.
So now you can be more precise on finding the right angle.

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Pathfinders: Memories - Full version released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/f7349379270a52ec7d8c29a72d348bb8442a7fd1.jpg[/img]

Pathfinders: Memories has just been released in Full Version!

Use your memory to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

The final version adds these features:

- The final civilization - England in Industrial Revolution - is available, completing the total of six civilizations - Ancient Rome, Ancient Egypt, the Vikings, Mali Empire, the Arabs, and Industial England.

- The museum of the human civilizations - the gallery showcasing the relics found in each civilization can be visited at any time. Find all of them to complete the museum!

Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294780/Pathfinders_Memories/


We thank everyone who supported us during Early Access by playing the game.

We are a small game studio focused on creating games that are simple but provide a pleasant experience to the player, mostly solving puzzles (either logic, word, jigsaw) in a relaxing environment, without timers or rush.

Follow our studio page on Steam to keep up-to-date with our releases!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/e238fb9687991fc84da9d176fa62d3c9f855ecc1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/ca165361bc507ac8955db123a66ccdbe0530b224.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mini Tone Update!
notes.content:
Hi, folks! 
Thank you for playing [b]Mini Tone[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/9e8964226d87b07ef673d10c6bf93504d6a88083.png[/img]

Based on your feedback we've released an update with new features.
They include:
[list]
[*] a marker on previous throw position, so that player can plan next throw based on that;
[*] tips for the player - if you get stuck in a level, tips will be offered;
[*] improved color palette change, with a reset to default palette option;
[*] some balancing on level progression.
[/list]
And, in further updates, expect new levels and achievements!
We hope you enjoy it! 

Leave your review on the store, that motivates and helps us to keep improving the game.

Preview of new features:
Marker:
 [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/fa3d8bb4dabb53e3cade03514e70479a23321789.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/9076273eabbd7bcd2403df76bfcbc1207384adbe.png[/img][/url]

Tip system:
 [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/a3a711b317e63f6b655345e74f1cdc7ac77e79eb.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/54998f37938984e174fc97be26b8e41c26ea0ea8.png[/img][/url]

Color Palette:
 [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/6341ae12605d763b9dda2921c3217c1719748ab7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/7423eb5560df81949f68871a3f02a690538ce055.png[/img][/url]
